summary: Specifies how to carry Enhanced Variable Rate Wideband Codec (EVRC-WB) speech in RTP, and updates media type registrations for EVRC-B. It also defines a file format for storing EVRC-WB speech, such as in email. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: This is a packing guide for sending a certain kind of compressed voice over the internet, plus a way to save it as a file.
